trans.en: used to show that you are talking about someone or something that has not been mentioned before, or that your listener does not know about

sentences.en: We have a problem.
sentences.cn: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

sentences.en: There was a hole in the fence.
sentences.cn: 篱笆上有一个洞。

sentences.en: How could she abandon her own child?
sentences.cn: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子？

sentences.en: ...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.
sentences.cn: …她父亲对她的彻底抛弃的那些记忆。

trans.en: a short form of a word or expression

sentences.en: ‘Dr’ is the written abbreviation of ‘Doctor’.
sentences.cn: Dr是Doctor的书面缩写形式。

sentences.cn: 我讨厌和没有幽默感的人打交道。

sentences.en: You'll have to abide by the rules of the club.
sentences.cn: 你必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

trans.en: the state of being able to do something

sentences.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
sentences.cn: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

sentences.cn: 这两个孩子出生时都比较大，但并非异常的大。

sentences.cn: 这样，如果该函数或过程崩溃或者异常终止，也不会对其他实例进程产生任何影响。

sentences.cn: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

sentences.en: The boat swayed as he stepped aboard.
sentences.cn: 他上船时，船晃了起来。

sentences.cn: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

sentences.en: The abolition of slavery in Brazil and the Caribbean closely followed the pattern of the United States.
sentences.cn: 巴西和加勒比海地区对奴隶制的废除很大程度上遵循了美国的模式。

sentences.en: anti-abortion campaigners

trans.en: concerning or relating to a particular subject

sentences.cn: 一本有关政治的书

sentences.cn: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

sentences.en: He lived in a flat above the shop.
sentences.cn: 他住在那商店上面的一套房间里。

sentences.en: The airliner flew above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 大型客机在云层上面飞行。

phrases.cn: 自高自大；趾高气扬；兴高采烈

sentences.cn: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

sentences.en: She often goes abroad on business.
sentences.cn: 她经常出国公干。

sentences.cn: 计划的突然改变

sentences.cn: 这条路突然到头了。

sentences.en: The ground rises abruptly.
sentences.cn: 地势突然隆起。

phrases.cn: 缺乏，不存在；无…时，缺少…时

sentences.cn: 他已经两个星期没来了。

sentences.cn: 电视上播放的有些东西简直就是垃圾。

sentences.en: How did you do that? You’re an absolute genius.
sentences.cn: 你是怎么做的？ 你绝对是个天才。

sentences.cn: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

sentences.en: Are you absolutely sure?
sentences.cn: 你绝对肯定吗？

sentences.cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

phrases.cn: 原子吸收；原子吸收作用

sentences.cn: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

sentences.cn: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

sentences.cn: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

sentences.cn: 浓密的红色鬈发

sentences.cn: 充足的淡水供应

sentences.cn: 提供给高素质的员工的大量机会

sentences.cn: 他没有学历。

sentences.en: a program to raise academic standards
sentences.cn: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

trans.en: a college where students are taught a particular subject or skill

sentences.en: a military academy
sentences.cn: 军事学院

sentences.en: the Royal Academy of Music
sentences.cn: 皇家音乐学院

trans.en: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect

sentences.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

trans.en: a process in which something happens more and more quickly

sentences.cn: 这款最新型号加速性能优异。

phrases.cn: 峰值加速度；最大加速度值

sentences.cn: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

sentences.en: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
sentences.cn: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

phrases.cn: 验收；最终验收；最后验收

the right to enter a place, use something, see someone etc

sentences.en: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.
sentences.cn: 有座教堂离我家很近。

phrases.cn: 易接近的；易达到的；可存取的

not the most important when compared to others

sentences.cn: 谋杀案的帮凶

sentences.en: the accessory muscles of respiration
sentences.cn: 副呼吸肌

sentences.cn: 每年在道路事故中受重伤的有七万多人。

sentences.en: The accident happened at the junction of Forest Road and Pine Walk.
sentences.cn: 事故发生在森林路与松树路的交叉口。

sentences.en: an accidental discharge of toxic waste
sentences.cn: 有毒废料的意外排放

sentences.cn: 购买一份意外损害保单。

sentences.en: She accidentally erased the tape.
sentences.cn: 她意外地抹去了录了音的磁带。

sentences.cn: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

sentences.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
sentences.cn: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

sentences.cn: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

sentences.en: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
sentences.cn: 大功告成。

sentences.cn: 你不会得到任何特殊待遇。

sentences.cn: 有些法律相互矛盾，因此，采取了措施将其阐明。

sentences.cn: 去年的账目显示利润为200万美元。

phrases.cn: 在某人帐上重视，	记帐
对…负有责任；对…做出解释；说明……的原因

sentences.cn: 医院应当对医护质量负责。

sentences.cn: 他正在学习会计学或他是一名会计专业的学生。

sentences.cn: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

sentences.cn: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

sentences.cn: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

sentences.cn: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

sentences.cn: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

phrases.cn: 痛苦；不适；各种各样的病痛

sentences.cn: 克莱尔承认有罪。

sentences.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .

sentences.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

sentences.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
sentences.cn: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

trans.cn: 取得， 获得， 习得； 获得物， 增添的人

sentences.en: the acquisition of language
sentences.cn: 语言的习得

phrases.cn: 数据采集系统；资料获取系统

sentences.cn: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

sentences.cn: 一片200英亩的林地

phrases.cn: 全面地；包括一切地；以三等分的钱数赌同一匹马赢得前三名

one thing that you do

sentences.cn: 公司解雇他做得对。

sentences.en: The jury decided that Walker had acted in self-defence.
sentences.cn: 陪审团裁定沃克的行为属于自卫。

sentences.cn: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

sentences.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
sentences.cn: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

sentences.en: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
sentences.cn: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

sentences.en: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
sentences.cn: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

sentences.cn: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

sentences.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
sentences.cn: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

sentences.cn: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

sentences.en: fund-raising activities
sentences.cn: 筹款活动

sentences.cn: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

sentences.cn: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

sentences.cn: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

sentences.cn: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

sentences.cn: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

sentences.cn: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose

phrases.cn: 防疫；疫病防治；流行病预防

trans.cn: 一个事件； 插曲， 片段； 连续剧的一集

sentences.en: Watch next week’s thrilling episode!
sentences.cn: 请收看下周精彩的一集！

trans.en: a period of history

sentences.en: the Victorian epoch
sentences.cn: 维多利亚时代

sentences.en: The king’s death marked the end of an epoch.
sentences.cn: 这位国王的去世标志着一个时代的结束。

trans.en: the same in size, number, amount, value etc as something else

sentences.en: Our constitution states that all men are equal.
sentences.cn: 我们的宪法规定人人平等。

trans.en: a situation in which people have the same rights, advantages etc

sentences.en: ...equality of the sexes.
sentences.cn: …性别平等。

trans.en: a statement in mathematics that shows that two amounts or totals are equal

sentences.en: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
sentences.cn: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

sentences.cn: 政府急切希望不要打乱经济平衡。

sentences.en: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
sentences.cn: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

sentences.en: a shop selling camping equipment
sentences.cn: 出售露营装备的商店

sentences.en: some brand new computer equipment
sentences.cn: 一些全新的计算机设备

sentences.en: ...the equivalence of science and rationality.
sentences.cn: ...科学和理性的相等。

trans.en: having the same value, purpose, job etc as a person or thing of a different kind

sentences.cn: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

phrases.cn: 等效应力；折算应力；相当应力

trans.en: a period of time in history that is known for a particular event, or for particular qualities

sentences.en: His death marked the end of an era.
sentences.cn: 他的去世标志着一个时代的终结。

sentences.en: the Victorian era
sentences.cn: 维多利亚时代

trans.en: to completely get rid of something such as a disease or a social problem

sentences.cn: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

sentences.en: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
sentences.cn: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

sentences.cn: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

sentences.cn: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

sentences.en: the erosion of the coastline

phrases.cn: n. 水土流失；土壤侵蚀；土壤流失；泥土流失

sentences.en: She was always sending me on errands.
sentences.cn: 她老是支使我。

sentences.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.

sentences.en: an error message

sentences.cn: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

sentences.en: A political row erupted over the MP’s comments.
sentences.cn: 这名下院议员的评论引发了一场政治论战。

the act of getting away from a place, or a dangerous or bad situation

phrases.cn: 迂回进路；脱险通道；疏散路线

trans.en: to take someone somewhere, especially when you are protecting or guarding them
a person or a group of people or vehicles that go with someone in order to protect or guard them

sentences.en: a police escort
sentences.cn: 警察护卫队

sentences.cn: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

sentences.cn: 我们让杰森写一篇关于他家乡的短文。

sentences.cn: 实质上他想表达的意思很简单。

sentences.cn: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

sentences.cn: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

sentences.en: Ballet is essentially a middle-class interest.
sentences.cn: 芭蕾舞基本上是中产阶级感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: Suicide rates have remained essentially unchanged.
sentences.cn: 自杀率基本上保持不变。

trans.en: to start a company, organization, system, etc that is intended to exist or continue for a long time

sentences.cn: 博恩市是德国移民于19世纪40年代建立的。

trans.en: the act of starting an organization, relationship, or system

sentences.en: a country estate
sentences.cn: 乡村的庄园

phrases.cn: 房地产市场；不动产市场

trans.en: a feeling of respect for someone, or a good opinion of someone

sentences.en: After that, we could go for esteem and respect.
sentences.cn: 而再往上，我们可能需要自尊和尊重。

sentences.en: This is why I esteem the individual only because he strikes me as ridiculous and humiliated.
sentences.cn: 这是我为什么尊重个体，就是因为他让我深深地感到荒诞和屈辱。

trans.cn: 美学的， 审美的； 悦目的， 雅致的

trans.en: to try to judge the value, size, speed, cost etc of something, without calculating it exactly

sentences.en: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.

trans.en: continuing for ever and having no end

sentences.en: the Christian promise of eternal life
sentences.cn: 基督教承诺的永生

sentences.en: She’s an eternal optimist (= she always expects that good things will happen ).
sentences.cn: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

trans.en: relating to a particular race, nation, or tribe and their customs and traditions

sentences.en: The school teaches pupils from different ethnic groups.

phrases.cn: n. 同种同文化之民族

sentences.en: eastern Europe

someone from Europe

sentences.cn: 欧洲的语言

trans.en: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is

sentences.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
sentences.cn: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

sentences.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
sentences.cn: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

sentences.cn: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

sentences.en: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
sentences.cn: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

trans.en: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas
if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas

sentences.cn: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

sentences.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
sentences.cn: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

sentences.cn: 我们将在平安夜到达。

sentences.cn: 利润将由我们三人平分。

sentences.cn: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

sentences.cn: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

sentences.cn: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

sentences.cn: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

sentences.cn: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

sentences.cn: 她显然烟瘾很大。

sentences.en: He was evidently in pain.
sentences.cn: 他显然很痛。

sentences.cn: 她想保护她的孩子不受外界的不良影响。

sentences.cn: 学校逐步形成了自己的教学风格。

sentences.cn: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

sentences.en: What were his exact words?
sentences.cn: 他的原话是什么？

phrases.cn: [非规范用语]正是同一个，正是这个；完全相同的

sentences.en: It’s exactly half past five.
sentences.cn: 一分不差，正好5点半。

sentences.en: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
sentences.cn: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

sentences.cn: 我三天没睡觉了——一点不夸张。

sentences.cn: 说我们是密友不免言过其实了。

sentences.cn: 说人人都会受到新政策的影响一点也不夸张。

sentences.cn: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

sentences.en: How did you do in your exams?

trans.en: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one

sentences.en: The examination results will be announced in September.
sentences.cn: 考试成绩将于9月公布。

sentences.en: He’s already taken the entrance examination.
sentences.cn: 他已经参加了入学考试。

trans.en: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it

sentences.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
sentences.cn: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

sentences.cn: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

trans.en: a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group

sentences.cn: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

trans.en: to be more than a particular number or amount

sentences.cn: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

sentences.en: His performance exceeded our expectations.
sentences.cn: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

trans.en: extremely

sentences.cn: 谢谢，你真是太好了。

sentences.cn: 里克一向擅长外语。

sentences.cn: 极好的建议

sentences.cn: 他的汽车状况极佳。

sentences.en: We all went except him.
sentences.cn: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

sentences.cn: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

sentences.cn: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

sentences.cn: 过高的价格

sentences.cn: “不！”她惊呼道。

sentences.en: horrified exclamations of disgust
sentences.cn: 厌恶的惊叫

trans.en: to deliberately not include something

sentences.cn: 不包含奶制品的特别食谱

sentences.cn: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

trans.cn: 奢华的，高级的；独有的，独享的；排斥的，排他的；不包括…的，不把…计算在内的

an important or exciting story that is printed in only one newspaper, because that newspaper was the first to find out about it

sentences.cn: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

phrases.cn: 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

sentences.cn: 她看到一个人影面朝大海坐着，一动不动。

trans.en: the effect or influence that an event, situation etc has on someone or something

sentences.cn: 他们说期望这次会议对国家的未来产生显著的影响。

sentences.cn: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

sentences.cn: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

sentences.cn: 我们就税收和保险问题提供公充的建议。

sentences.cn: 不耐烦的司机们在按喇叭发嘟嘟声。

phrases.cn: 祈使语气；命令语气；祈使式

sentences.cn: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

sentences.cn: 政府许诺要实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

sentences.cn: 它们被称作“超级电车”，这是暗指它们比先前的型号更先进。

trans.cn: 不言明的， 含蓄的； 内含的， 固有的； 无疑问的
trans.en: suggested or understood without being stated directly

sentences.cn: …叫摩洛哥人不要继续或重复一周前开始的军事行动的含蓄警告。

phrases.cn: 进出口；导入和导出；输入和输出

phrases.cn: 有着重要意义，十分重要
重要的；具有重要意义的

sentences.cn: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

phrases.cn: 最重要的；首要的；最关键的

sentences.cn: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

sentences.cn: 这些数字看上去确实很可观。

sentences.cn: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

sentences.en: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
sentences.cn: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

to make something better, or to become better

sentences.cn: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

sentences.cn: 关于他的文字描述有大量失实之处。

sentences.cn: 年轻人越来越不相信任何形式的政府。

sentences.cn: 并且如果顾客不能访问你的系统或业务不能进行工作，那么由可靠性或性能问题引起的运作停工就会招致机会成本。

sentences.cn: 有计划要把这家大企业分割成一些独立的小公司。

sentences.cn: 这一行为恐怕已表明了她的总体态度。

sentences.cn: 查尔斯发现他的名字没有出现在名单上，这让他深感愤慨。

sentences.en: My worst fear was that we would run out of food.
sentences.cn: 我最大的担忧是我们会把食物吃光。

phrases.cn: 十分；非常；强烈地（等于in the worst way）

trans.en: an amount of something worth ten pounds, $500 etc

sentences.en: You should not deprecate your own worth.
sentences.cn: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

trans.en: something that is worthless has no value, importance, or use

sentences.en: The house was full of worthless junk.
sentences.cn: 这房子里堆满了没有用的东西。

sentences.en: The information was worthless to me.
sentences.cn: 这些资料对我毫无用处。

trans.en: if something is worthwhile, it is important or useful, or you gain something from it

sentences.en: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
sentences.cn: 他想做有意义的工作。

sentences.en: We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
sentences.cn: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

trans.en: deserving respect from people

sentences.en: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
sentences.cn: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

sentences.en: a worthy opponent
sentences.cn: 值得钦佩的对手

trans.en: an injury to your body that is made by a weapon such as a knife or a bullet

sentences.en: A nurse cleaned and bandaged the wound.
sentences.cn: 护士把伤口清洗包扎好。

sentences.en: It took several months for his wounds to heal .
sentences.cn: 他的伤口几个月后才愈合。

phrases.cn: 创伤修复，愈合；伤口愈合

trans.en: to put paper or cloth over something to cover it
a piece of thick cloth that a woman wears around her shoulders

sentences.en: I’ve still got a few Christmas presents to wrap up.
sentences.cn: 我还有一些圣诞礼物要包起来。

phrases.cn: 伪装；使全神贯注；穿暖和的衣服

trans.en: extreme anger

sentences.en: He was scared of incurring his father’s wrath .
sentences.cn: 他害怕惹他父亲大发脾气。

phrases.cn: 神的忿怒；神之愤怒；上帝的惩罚

trans.en: a ship that has sunk
to completely spoil something so that it cannot continue in a successful way

sentences.en: ...the wreck of a sailing ship.
sentences.cn: …一艘帆船的残骸。

trans.en: to twist and pull something roughly from the place where it is being held
a twisting movement that pulls something violently

sentences.en: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
sentences.cn: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

sentences.en: He grabbed the rope and gave it a wrench.
sentences.cn: 他抓住绳子猛地一拉。

phrases.cn: 扭力扳手；转矩扳手；定力矩扳手

trans.en: the act or about of wrestling
someone who is wretched is very unhappy or ill, and you feel sorry for them

sentences.en: the poor, wretched girl
sentences.cn: 极其不幸的可怜姑娘

trans.en: to tightly twist a wet cloth or wet clothes in order to remove water

sentences.en: This jacket’s wringing wet!
sentences.cn: 这件上衣湿得都能拧出水来！

phrases.cn: 高级特技飞行；绞出；扭干
浑身湿透；(衣服)湿得拧得出水来

trans.en: wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old
if you wrinkle a part of your face, or if it wrinkles, small lines appear on it

sentences.en: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
sentences.cn: 她的脸上布满皱纹。

sentences.en: Alex wrinkled up her nose at the smell.
sentences.cn: 闻到那股味道，亚历克丝皱起了鼻子。

trans.en: the part of your body where your hand joins your arm

sentences.en: He broke his wrist climbing rocks for a cigarette ad.
sentences.cn: 他为了一个香烟广告攀岩折断了手腕。

trans.en: someone who writes books, stories etc, especially as a job

sentences.en: She’s one of my favourite writers.
sentences.cn: 她是我最喜欢的作家之一。

sentences.en: a science-fiction writer
sentences.cn: 科幻小说作家

trans.en: books, poems, articles etc, especially those by a particular writer or about a particular subject

sentences.en: Some of his most powerful writing is based on his childhood experiences.
sentences.cn: 他的一些最震慑人心的作品是根据儿时经历写成的。

trans.en: a beam of radiation1 that can go through solid objects and is used for photographing the inside of the body

sentences.en: The X-ray showed that her leg was not broken.
sentences.cn: X光片显示她的腿没有骨折。

trans.en: to make a copy of a letter, document, etc. by using Xerox or a similar process

sentences.en: Could you xerox this letter, please?
sentences.cn: 请复印一下这封信好吗？

trans.en: a large boat with a sail, used for pleasure or sport, especially one that has a place where you can sleep

sentences.en: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer.
sentences.cn: 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。

trans.en: an enclosed area next to a building or group of buildings, used for a special purpose, activity, or business

sentences.en: a builder’s yard
sentences.cn: 建筑工地

sentences.en: a timber yard
sentences.cn: 木场

trans.en: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored
an act of yawning

sentences.en: Alan stretched and yawned.
sentences.cn: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

trans.en: happening or appearing every year or once a year
Yearly is also an adverb

sentences.en: Salary levels are reviewed on a yearly basis.
sentences.cn: 工资水平每年都要审查。

sentences.en: a total yearly income of $78,000
sentences.cn: 7.8万美元的年总收入

trans.en: to have a strong desire for something, especially something that is difficult or impossible to get

sentences.en: Hannah yearned for a child.
sentences.cn: 汉娜渴望有个孩子。

trans.en: a type of fungus used for producing alcohol in beer and wine, and for making bread rise

sentences.en: dried/fresh yeast
sentences.cn: 干／新鲜酵母

sentences.en: yeast extract
sentences.cn: 酵母精

trans.en: to shout or say something very loudly, especially because you are frightened, angry, or excited

sentences.en: ‘Help me!’ she yelled hysterically.
sentences.cn: “救救我！”她歇斯底里地大叫。

sentences.en: I yelled out, ‘Here I am!’
sentences.cn: 我大声喊道:“我在这儿！”

trans.en: to produce a result, answer, or piece of information
the amount of profits, crops etc that something produces

sentences.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
sentences.cn: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

phrases.cn: 屈服强度；屈变力；抗屈强度

trans.en: a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads

sentences.en: the yoke of imperialism
sentences.cn: 帝国主义的枷锁

trans.en: the yellow part in the centre of an egg

sentences.en: Only the yolk contains cholesterol.
sentences.cn: 只有蛋黄含胆固醇。

trans.cn: 青年， 年轻人， 孩子
trans.en: a child or young person

sentences.en: Other youngsters are not so lucky.
sentences.cn: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

trans.en: the period of time when someone is young, especially the period when someone is a teenager

sentences.en: Despite his youth, he had travelled alone.
sentences.cn: 他虽然年纪还小，却已独自旅行过了。

phrases.cn: 青年招待所；青年（学生）宿舍

trans.en: a blue-white metal that is used to make brass and to cover and protect objects made of iron. It is a chemical element: symbol Zn

sentences.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
sentences.cn: 黄铜是铜锌合金。

trans.en: a large area that is different from other areas around it in some way

sentences.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
sentences.cn: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

sentences.en: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
sentences.cn: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

phrases.cn: 经济特区；经济圈；经济地带
